_about: Real open-source projects, fetched at pinned commits. must = fnmatch patterns over finding fingerprints that the scan has to report (a real gap in that code); must_not = patterns it must never report (a false alarm). Every expectation was checked by reading the code at the pinned commit; the reason is in 'why'. Profiles are fixed answers to the intake questions, chosen to match what each project is. known_gaps = real gaps the scan misses today: listed in RESULTS.md, not counted as failures, to fix later.

repos.name: saas-starter
repos.kind: SaaS starter: Stripe subscriptions, Drizzle, own auth

why.privacy.policy_missing: No privacy page anywhere in app/.
why.terms.no_clickwrap|app/(login)/login.tsx: login.tsx renders the sign-up form (mode 'signup') with no link to terms or privacy.
why.payments.renewal_disclosure: lib/payments/stripe.ts creates a subscription with a 14-day trial; no page says it renews or how to cancel.
why.payments.refund_missing: Charges via Stripe, no refund policy.
why.rights.export_missing: No way to download account data.

why.terms.no_clickwrap|components/ui/AuthFor: Sign-up form has no terms or privacy link.
why.rights.delete_missing: Only Stripe product/price records are deleted (utils/supabase/admin.ts); no account deletion.
why.payments.renewal_disclosure: Subscription pricing with no renewal wording.
why.terms.no_clickwrap|*EmailSignIn*: Sign-in form; it only links to /signin/signup.

why.privacy.policy_outdated|Stripe: content/pages/privacy.mdx is lorem ipsum and names no service, but the app uses Stripe.
why.privacy.policy_outdated|Postmark: Same policy; sign-in emails go through Postmark (lib/auth.ts).
why.payments.renewal_disclosure: Pro plan is a Stripe subscription; pricing has no renewal wording.
why.claims.*|guaranteed: 'three is guaranteed to be a bad idea' in sample blog prose, not a marketing claim.
why.assets.ui_kit|*: Used to match Postmark's 'TemplateModel' in lib/auth.ts.
why.payments.cancel_missing: Stripe billing portal and cancel_at_period_end in the billing page.
why.cookies.no_consent|*: Only Vercel Analytics, which sets no cookies.

why.ai.disclosure_missing|*: No text anywhere tells users replies are AI-generated or can be wrong.
why.rights.delete_missing: Users can delete chats (deleteAllChatsByUserId) but not their account.
why.ugc.*: File uploads are private chat attachments, and the profile isn't a marketplace.

known_gaps.terms.no_clickwrap: app/(auth)/register/page.tsx shows a sign-up form with no terms link, but its inputs live in components/chat/auth-form.tsx, so the scan doesn't see it.

repos.name: chatbot-ui
repos.kind: AI chat app, Supabase, file uploads

why.ai.disclosure_missing|*: 'AI assistant' only appears inside system prompts sent to the model; nothing tells the user.
why.terms.no_clickwrap|app/[locale]/login/pa: The login page calls supabase signUp with no terms link.
why.licenses.unknown|*: package-lock.json has no license fields at all (older npm); used to report 893 'unknown' packages.
why.a11y.img_alt: Every <Image> sets alt, on a later line after an arrow function in src.
why.ugc.*: Uploads are private files for chat, not public content.

repos.name: commerce

why.privacy.policy_missing: Analytics configured in data/siteMetadata.js and no privacy page.
why.cookies.no_consent|*: Default analytics is Umami, which sets no cookies.
why.a11y.img_alt: The only '' is a mention inside backticks in a blog post.

why.rights.export_missing: Clerk has no self-serve data download.
why.rights.delete_missing: Clerk's <UserButton> (components/layout/navbar.tsx) includes Delete account, once it's enabled in the Clerk dashboard.
